capture.title: Demo workload profile exercising every counting law
capture.note: NO hosted beta exists yet (recorded external gate). This profile is a SYNTHETIC demonstration of the schema and counting laws with invented numeric shapes. It must never be passed as measured: an honest beta profile overrides capture.source with 'beta' and fills windowStart/windowEnd/activeUsers from real observation.

foregroundTurns.chunkingLaw: 61200 chunks across 48000 distinct questions: each logical question spans on average 1.275 chunks; chunks aggregate to 1 logical turn for planning, each chunk is one admission event for runtime/token accounting.

deviceSyncPolls.pollingLaw: Device sync/visibility polls are cheap API requests. They add to API request volume and request-seconds but are NEVER counted as AI turns.

synchronizedClassStarts.classStartLaw: Synchronized class starts concentrate demand into burst windows. The measured peak/mean ratio (92/7.4 ~= 12.4) is the peak-concurrency multiplier; spreading the same turns uniformly would understate peak demand. This multiplier is reported as a capacity guardrail and feeds effective-concurrency admission.

providerRetries.retryLaw: Retries are measured as attempts per primary logical turn. Attempts (including retries) drive provider cost and runtime seconds; a retry is NEVER a new logical turn.

offlineReconnects.law: An offline reconnect is a replay/sync work item counted once per reconnect, never as new user questions.

buildRuns.buildLaw: A declarative Build run is one logical work item even when it spans several generation chunks. Build chunks add admission/token/runtime volume; a Build is never counted as a foreground user question.

voice.voiceLaw: Voice turns are measured by audio duration, not by an invented text-only figure: ASR input tokens derive from capture minutes, TTS output audio bytes derive from spoken output seconds, and the turn wall-time includes capture + ASR + TTS. These durations replace the text-baseline guess for voice turns.
